card.what: Masthead wind indicator for keelboats of about 20 to 40 ft, 15 in (381 mm) vane: a black socket screwed to the masthead, a stainless stalk, a vane turning on a bearing at its top (arrow and counterweight forward, a swept fin with reflective film aft) and two fixed reference tabs on wire arms set aft at the close-hauled angle. Size 10 is the 10 in dinghy model
card.boats: the J/22 (game: SailboatPawn's MastheadFly, today two black boxes), the fleet's keelboats and catamarans (build_fleet.py draws a bare 0.35 m stick); not the Sunfish or ILCA, which carry none
card.distance: looked up at from the cockpit 9 to 10 m below; the chase and photo cameras pass it at a few metres; the dock camera sees it against the sky
card.before: the game's fly (SailboatPawn: FlyArrow, a 450 x 25 x 25 mm box, and FlyVane, a 120 x 10 x 100 mm box, floating 80 mm above the masthead with no stalk); the kit had no part

references.use: in use: a keelboat's masthead fly at Rush Creek against an overcast sky (Bean's own photo IMG_9224, Oct 4 2026, a crop of a marina mast with no people): tall thin stalk, the vane dark against the sky with a swept tall fin aft, a tab arm out to the side, a bird spike above
references.url: Bean's J/22 lesson photo IMG_9224 (project files, sailing-sim-ref/j22-lessons); measure and compare only, not in the repo
Davis Instruments WindTrak / Windex 15 #3150 listings (Lowe's, Landfall Navigation, iboats) and Windex 10 listings (Toplicht, Kildale Marine)
references.note: 15 in (381 mm) vane, 12.75 in (324 mm) tall, about 101 g; optional bird spike about 10 in (240 mm); 10 in model 254 mm long, 240 mm tall, 34 to 38 g, top or side mount. Assembly sheet: tabs set to the boat's angle from a template on the box, then turned on the shaft until symmetric aft; socket screwed to the masthead with #10 screws

sizes.name: Vane length, arrow tip to fin's trailing edge
Overall height, socket foot to fin top

features.text: Black flanged socket screwed to the masthead, a tapered boss and a lock collar gripping the stalk
Thin stainless stalk standing straight up
Bearing cap at the stalk's top, the vane's arm through its head
Barbed arrowhead forward with red reflectors, a counterweight behind it
Tall fin aft with a swept leading edge, mostly black with reflective film both sides
Two reference tabs on wire arms from a collar below the vane, set aft at about 34 degrees each side
The vane is a separate part turning about the stalk (MastheadFlyVane + MastheadFlyMount for the game)
Black plastic, stainless, red and white reflective film

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; at 9 m up the light copy (a quarter) is what the game draws most of the time
